procedures.title: Manual transmission special tools
notes: Figure 24 in the manual shows: J-0933 clutch gear bearing retainer wrench; J-1126 transmission guide pins; J-8059 retainer snap ring pliers; J-21629 and J-22246 countergear loading tools; J-5778 extension housing bushing remover/installer; J-5154 extension housing seal installer; J-5814-15 speedometer drive gear remover; J-1453-01 speedometer drive gear press plates; J-9771 press plates (not shown); J-358-1 press plate holder; J-4653 overdrive governor wrench; J-5590 clutch gear bearing installer; J-7785 clutch gear retainer lip seal installer.
